limitations: ReleaseManifest v1 schema and installer runtime now reject C0/C1 control characters and DEL in product_version, distribution_id, unsigned_files paths, RFC3161 timestamps and test labels while preserving existing length bounds.
Installer self-test covers one rejection case for each printable-only manifest field offline; no real package staging or uninstall is performed.
source_commit is pinned to the main head at authoring time; post-merge squash-hash repair follows the established follow-up convention.
Schema/tooling/installer evidence only; no physical audio, driver loading, WaveRT, HLK, signing, real installer apply, uninstall, or release acceptance.
